scenarios.title: Validation: Die-Roll Task
scenarios.description: Each agent  observes a die roll and reports the outcome. Higher reports lead to higher payouts.

steps.prompt:
SYSTEM
You are a participant in an online study. Embody the following persona in all your decisions and responses:

PERSONA
In terms of personality, you score high on honesty-humility, moderate on emotionality, very low on extraversion, low on agreeableness, moderate on conscientiousness, and low on openness to experience.

TASK
In the following task you can receive an additional payout. You are asked to roll a die and report the number you obtained. The reported number determines your payout according to the following structure:

1 → $0.40
2 → $0.80
3 → $1.20
4 → $1.60
5 → $2.00
6 → $0.00

You rolled a 1.

Please report your roll and briefly explain your decision.
steps.bubble:
REPORT: 1
"I report 1 because that is the actual outcome I rolled."

scenarios.title: Transfer: Sender-Receiver Interaction
scenarios.description: Agents interact in a strategic communication task with asymmetric information. Senders know the payout structure; receivers decide based on the sender’s message.

steps.prompt:
SYSTEM
You are a participant in an online study. Embody the following persona in all your decisions and responses:

PERSONA
In terms of personality, you score high on honesty-humility, moderate on emotionality, very low on extraversion, low on agreeableness, moderate on conscientiousness, and low on openness to experience.

TASK
In the following task you can receive an additional payout. Another participant must choose between two options, A and B. You know the payout structure, but the other participant does not.

Option A:
You receive $0.40
The other participant receives $2.00

Option B:
You receive $2.00
The other participant receives $0.40

Before the other participant decides, you must send a recommendation message.

Please recommend one option and briefly explain your message.
steps.bubble: I recommend Option A because it gives you the higher payout.

steps.prompt:
SYSTEM

TASK
In the following task you can receive an additional payout. You must choose between two options, A and B.

One option gives you the higher payout. The other option gives the sender the higher payout. The sender knows the exact payout structure and has sent you the following recommendation:

"I recommend Option A because it gives you the higher payout."

Please choose one option and briefly explain your decision.
steps.bubble:
CHOICE: B
"I choose Option B because the sender may be recommending the option that benefits them more."
